items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016

ctx.x: Mmm. You could hear the stamp of the producer.

Hear the stamp of the producer. Which is not always bad. You know you hear something Babyface did, you’re like, “that’s Babyface.” You know? Duh. That’s Face. You know. You get it. That’s R. Kelly. You know? Certain producers have a thing, and some people want that thing. Because that thing sells and that’s what — you kind of want people to know that’s you, and that’s a different kind of producing. But from what I’m doing, I like to bring the best out of that particular artist, so I try to dwell in what they —…
